reviews.rationale: The packet lacks a complete, non-overlapping reconstruction of OpenAI's obligations on September 29, 2025. Partial partnership disclosures cannot establish either the trillion-dollar threshold or an upper bound. Announced financing also neither establishes a comprehensive funding plan nor proves its absence.
